# Rumble triggers

## Chat command

Runs when a viewer types a command like !hello in your Rumble chat. Cuebot cuts the words after it into variables.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The word viewers type, with the ! in front, like "!hello". Starts as: `!hello`. |
| **Match** | "Starts with" also runs when the viewer adds words after it ("!so bob"). "Exact" runs only when the message is the command alone. Options: Starts with, Exact. Starts as: `Starts with`. |
| **Who can use it** | The lowest role that may use it: Everyone, Subscriber, Moderator or Broadcaster (you). Higher roles can always use it. Options: Everyone, Subscriber, Moderator, Broadcaster. Starts as: `Everyone`. |
| **Global cooldown (seconds)** | Seconds to wait before anyone can use it again. 0 means no wait. Example: 30. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Per-user cooldown (seconds)** | Seconds each viewer must wait before using it again. 0 means no wait. Example: 60. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Case sensitive** | Tick to care about capital letters, so "!Hello" no longer matches "!hello". Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the viewer |
| `%command%` | The command they typed |
| `%input%` | Everything after the command |
| `%input0%` | The first word after the command (then input1, input2...) |
| `%inputCount%` | How many words came after the command |
| `%message%` | The whole message |
| `%isModerator%` | True if they are a moderator |
| `%isSubscriber%` | True if they are a subscriber |

<small>Type id: `rumble.command`</small>

## Chat message

Runs when someone writes in your Rumble live chat. Needs a live stream and your Live Stream API link in the Rumble settings.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message contains** | Only run when the message has this text in it, like "hello". Capital letters do not matter. Leave empty to run for every message. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the person who wrote |
| `%message%` | What they wrote |
| `%isModerator%` | True if they are a moderator |
| `%isSubscriber%` | True if they are a subscriber |
| `%isRant%` | True if it was a paid Rant |
| `%amount%` | The Rant amount in dollars (0 if not a Rant) |
| `%messageId%` | ID of the message, when Rumble gives one |

<small>Type id: `rumble.chatMessage`</small>

## Follow

Runs when someone follows your Rumble channel. Cuebot checks every few seconds. Good for a thank-you message.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the new follower |
| `%followedAt%` | When they followed |

<small>Type id: `rumble.follow`</small>

## Gift subscriptions

Runs when someone gifts subscriptions on your Rumble channel. Use it to thank the gifter.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum gifted** | Only run when at least this many subs were gifted. Example: 5. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the gifter |
| `%total%` | How many subs were gifted |
| `%remaining%` | How many are left to give out |

<small>Type id: `rumble.giftSub`</small>

## Rant

Runs when a viewer pays for a Rant (a highlighted paid message) in your Rumble chat. Good for a thank-you or an alert.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount ($)** | Only run for at least this many dollars. 0 runs for every Rant. Example: 5. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the sender |
| `%amount%` | How many dollars, as a number |
| `%amountText%` | The amount with the dollar sign, like $5.00 |
| `%message%` | The text that came with it |

<small>Type id: `rumble.rant`</small>

## Stream offline

Runs when your Rumble stream ends. Handy for a goodbye message.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | Your stream title |
| `%streamId%` | ID of the stream |

<small>Type id: `rumble.streamOffline`</small>

## Stream online

Runs when your Rumble stream goes live. Use it to say hello or switch scenes.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | Your stream title |
| `%streamId%` | ID of the stream |

<small>Type id: `rumble.streamOnline`</small>

## Subscription

Runs when someone subscribes to your Rumble channel. Good for a thank-you message or alert.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the new subscriber |
| `%amount%` | What they pay, in dollars (0 if Rumble does not say) |
| `%amountText%` | The amount with the dollar sign, like $5.00 |
| `%subscribedAt%` | When they subscribed |

<small>Type id: `rumble.subscribe`</small>
